summary: Embrace Change Acquisition Corp., a Cayman SPAC, disclosed in an 8-K that it received a termination notice from Tianji Tire Global on September 10, 2026, ending the January 26, 2025 merger agreement (amended October 16, 2025). Tianji invoked Section 11.1(d)(i), the Outside Date of August 12, 2026, after the business combination failed to close. EMCG is the acquirer via Cayman merger subsidiaries. No price, premium, break fee, or advisor is stated. With the de-SPAC terminated, the SPAC faces a charter deadline and possible liquidation or a new target; watch trust redemptions and whether a break fee is later claimed.
